title: temp_core full-signal-path mismatch Monte Carlo: PTAT temperature error (degC), untrimmed and 1-point trimmed, with per-term attribution
claim: Issue #105 -- evidence for DR-003 row 2 [TBD-1], NOT a spec claim and NOT an edit of the ratified spec. Measures the temperature error, in degC, of the PTAT readout of temp_core under local device mismatch across -40/27/125 C, untrimmed and with an ideal 27 C single-point gain trim, attributed to four terms: PNP ratio pair, amplifier input offset, resistor ratio (R2/R1), PMOS mirror ratio. Terms not measured are listed in every record; no complete aggregate is claimed beyond what the record states.
driver: run_accuracy_mc.py (bespoke: the claim is a distribution per (variant, temperature) with paired draws across temperature, not one scalar per PVT point, so sim/bin/corner-run.py's experiment.json flow does not apply; this file is the manifest the driver reads its conventions from by documentation, as in sim/pnp-mismatch/)
statistical_convention: 3 sigma = 3 x Bessel-corrected sample standard deviation of the per-sample temperature error (spec/porting-plan.md section 3.2 [3sigma]); empirical max |error| and 99.7th percentile reported alongside
temperature_error_definition: e(T) = (PTAT_sample(T) - PTAT_nominal(T)) / (dPTAT_nominal/dT at T), PTAT_nominal and its slope taken from the mismatch-free transfer function of the SAME process corner and supply (quadratic through -40/27/125 C). 1-point trim: PTAT_sample is multiplied by PTAT_nominal(27)/PTAT_sample(27) of the same sample (an ideal continuous gain trim, as DR-005 'single-point 25 C gain trim'), then e(T) as above; e(27) is 0 by construction

monte_carlo.pairing: one klt sim request per temperature, so corner_index and therefore the per-sample seed is identical across temperatures; validated by the cross-temperature correlation reported in each record

terms.pnp: native PDK Is/Bf mismatch of the PNP devices (sw_mm_sky130_fd_pr__pnp_05v5_W0p68L0p68_{is,bf}, scaled by the PDK for W3p40L3p40)
terms.res: native PDK xhigh_po body-resistance mismatch (sw_mm_sky130_fd_pr__res_xhigh_po / sqrt(W*L))
terms.amp: explicit series gate-voltage sources on MI1, MI2, ML1, ML2 with the PDK's own Vth mismatch sigma A_VT/sqrt(W*L)
terms.mirror: explicit series gate-voltage sources on MP1-3 and MPC1-3 with the same sigma law
terms.all: everything the PDK mismatches, native (adds bias_core, tail/startup/enable MOS, MIM cap)

operating_point_guards.windows: copied unrelaxed from sim/temp-core-startup/experiment.json (ptat 0.3-2.6 V, ctat 0.2-1.1 V, na/nb -1..4.7 V, isup 1e-8..5e-5 A, bias_ok 2.0..3.7 V)
operating_point_guards.settled: PTAT and CTAT move < 1 mV over the last 1 ms
operating_point_guards.invalid_samples: excluded from every statistic, counted per (group, temperature, reason) in the record, never replaced

deck.analysis: tran 10u 10m uic (power-up from 0 V, EN tied to VDD)

negative_controls: control-off (sampler on, all terms off: sigma must be 0)
control-zeroed (_mm section with every native coefficient overridden to 0: sigma must be 0)
execution: every request is `klt sim --backend batch` (Spot fleet); no local grid, no local fallback
cites: sim/temp-core-startup-solver/records/20261010-200708-47b96e5 (issue #86: partial solver sweep; justifies the operating-point guards)
